summary: Western Union filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an additional issuance of 4.750% senior unsecured notes due 2029. The offering size is $165,000,000 aggregate principal amount, reopening the existing $450,000,000 tranche issued March 9, 2026, bringing total outstanding to $615,000,000. The notes are offered at 98.793% of par with an underwriting discount of 0.250%, yielding net proceeds of approximately $162.6 million plus accrued interest. The notes are senior unsecured obligations ranking equally with existing senior debt. Settlement is T+3 via DTC. The filing is a routine debt offering, not a special situation. There are no equity, M&A, restructuring, or capital-return elements. Proceeds will likely be used for general corporate purposes. This is a straightforward corporate debt capital markets transaction with no special event trigger.
